confirmReocr.title: Have Claude read “{title}” again?
confirmReocr.body: Claude will look at each page that hasn't been read yet ({pages, plural, =0 {no pages yet} one {# page} other {up to # pages}}) — about half a minute each, so a whole book takes hours. You can close this page and come back later: pressing it again picks up where it stopped. Pages that are already read are left alone, and nothing you already have is lost.

compile.confirmBody: The assistant will read the whole book to find its concepts and connect them to your other books. It happens once — a book already in the canon is never re-read.
compile.confirmRecompileBody: This re-reads the WHOLE book with Claude — real time against your subscription — and REPLACES this book's current concepts in the canon with what it finds this time. Do this when the book's text has improved or you've switched to a better model. Your other books in the canon are untouched.

prompts.title: What the app tells the assistant
prompts.help: Every time the app asks the model for something, it sends a set of instructions along with it. Here they all are, exactly as they go out.
prompts.englishNote: These stay in English: this is exactly what the model receives, and translating it would change what it understands. You don't have to read them — each one has its explanation above it.
prompts.textLabel: The text that goes out, exactly as it goes out
prompts.fragmentNote: This is never sent on its own: it goes inside other prompts, where it's needed.
prompts.spanNote: The highlighted parts are your own data, in the place it lands inside the text. What you see here is a sample of it.
prompts.cacheNote: This sits in the part the model keeps in memory and reuses — which is why reading your library is billed once instead of once per lesson. If it changes, that memory is rebuilt one time, then it catches again.
prompts.editableTitle: The text is yours — change it however you like
prompts.historyEmpty: Nothing here yet. History keeps whatever you replaced, from your second change onwards — the original text is never lost, the code has it.
prompts.sliceCacheWarning: Careful: this text is inside the part that's kept in memory. If you change it, your library is read again and billed one more time — once, not once per lesson.

errors.unknown_prompt: That prompt doesn't exist any more. Refresh the page.
errors.unknown_slice: That part doesn't exist any more. Refresh the page.
errors.empty: This can't be left empty. If you want the original back, press Reset.
errors.too_long: That's too long. Keep it under {max} characters — it goes out with every lesson, which is why there's a limit.
errors.missing_placeholder: Something the text needs to work is missing. Press Reset and start again from the original.
errors.unknown_placeholder: You've added something in braces that the app doesn't know how to fill in. Take it out and try again.
errors.malformed_braces: There's a brace that never closes. Check the braces in the text.
errors.load_failed: The prompts didn't load. Refresh the page.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.

prompts.generatedTitle: This one isn't written by hand
prompts.generatedWhy: Nobody wrote this text sentence by sentence: the app generates it automatically from the assistant's list of tools. There is nothing to change here — your own words would make the assistant try to use tools that don't exist. It changes only when the tools themselves change.
prompts.editableHelp: Whatever you write here is what goes to the model, from the next time onwards. Put your own teaching ideas in: you know them, the model doesn't. Reset always brings the original back.
prompts.resetConfirmBody: The text you wrote will be deleted and replaced with the one the app started with. It isn't lost for good: you'll find it in History, just below.
prompts.languageOrigin: This screen doesn't decide the language here: the course's student does (the language on his card). That's why a course can be written in English while you're using the app in Greek.

curriculumGroup.title: Curriculum — the core prompts
curriculumGroup.help: The ten prompts that actually shape your curriculum and lessons — gathered here so you don't have to hunt for them inside the groups below.

blueprint.title: The lesson structure
blueprint.help: Every lesson the app writes is split into these pieces, in this order. Here you decide how much time goes to each one and who it's for — this applies to every NEW curriculum, not to the ones that already exist.
blueprint.weightHelp: How big this piece is relative to the others — they don't need to add up to 1.
blueprint.addStructuredFailed: Couldn't add this piece. Try again.
blueprint.structuredTooltipExercises: This piece holds the exercise steps the student actually plays, built on a fixed code schema — its type and key can't change, but you can turn it off, remove it, or add it back from the menu above.
blueprint.structuredTooltipQa: This piece holds the Q&A prompts and their answer keys, built on a fixed code schema — its type and key can't change, but you can turn it off, remove it, or add it back from the menu above.
blueprint.restoreConfirmBody: The structure you built will be deleted and replaced with the app's standard one. It doesn't affect curricula that already exist — only new ones will start from the standard structure from now on.

errors.bad_version: Something's off with the structure's format. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.no_sections: It needs at least one piece.
errors.bad_key: One of the pieces has an invalid key — only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.dup_key: Two pieces have the same key. Change one of them.
errors.bad_label: Every piece needs a title in both Greek and English.
errors.bad_description: Every piece needs a description — it can't be left empty.
errors.bad_weight: Weight must be a number between 0 and 1.
errors.bad_kind: One of the pieces has an unrecognized kind.
errors.bad_audience: Pick who the piece is for: teacher, student, or both.
errors.bad_enabled: Something's off with a piece's enabled/disabled state.
errors.structured_section_duplicate: Only one Exercises piece and one Q&A and discussion piece are allowed.
errors.structured_section_renamed: The key of a fixed piece (Exercises or Q&A and discussion) changed — that isn't allowed. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.no_enabled_sections: At least one piece must stay enabled.
errors.load_failed: The structure didn't load. Refresh the page.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
